description: TraSER collects traffic signal and detector events at signalised intersections. Its contributors provide a C++ recorder designed for NTCIP-compliant 2070 ATC controllers; the SoftwareX abstract also describes integrated video and field use. The event stream can be used to calibrate signal timing and validate intersection operations in road traffic simulations. Spatial coverage is the instrumented junction and temporal resolution follows recorded controller events; a study period is set by the deployment. Source is publicly accessible through the own GitHub repository without a fee. Its License.txt contains two BSD-style redistribution conditions, while the publisher code table labels the software GNU GPL without a version. The conflict should be resolved before redistribution. A limitation is the dependency on a compatible physical controller and legacy Windows tooling. No related catalogue record was identified. No controller, detector, video feed or event stream was connected.
